<function name="ContextMenuClosed" parent="SANDBOX" type="hook">
	<description>Called when the context menu is supposedly closed.

This is simply an alias of <page>GM:OnContextMenuClose</page>.

This hook **will** be called even if the Sandbox's context menu doesn't actually exist, i.e. <page>SANDBOX:ContextMenuEnabled</page> blocked its creation.

</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
</function>
